title: Grateful Dead Live at Exposition Center on 1971-03-21
lineage: AUD > MC > LP > Reel > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Incomplete, fair‑quality recording of a chaotic oversold show with no standout musical moments noted.
ai_review.review: The archive tape captures only the latter part of the concert, beginning after "Cold Rain and Snow" and missing several songs. Reviewers note crowd management problems and suggest the set may have been cut short, while the audio is described as historically limited in fidelity, leaving little to highlight musically.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between a modest 4‑star comment about context and several low or zero‑star notes focusing on missing material and poor historical recording quality, resulting in an overall below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recording starts mid‑song, omits the opening set, likely mono tape with limited fidelity; reviewers mention historical quality limiters and incomplete performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The captured portion begins after "Cold Rain and Snow" and runs only about 45 minutes, with the full set believed to be longer but not present; crowd oversell and fire‑marshal intervention are cited as reasons for a truncated or chaotic experience.
